evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, positioning self as one entitled to issue binding instructions to an audience expected to comply.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Bare imperative command continues the authority-ranking enactment — speaker directs an action of erasure with no hedging or reciprocity framing.
